title: localhost vs 127.0.0.1 hit different http.sys URL ACLs — hangs/503s while the server is healthy
symptoms: Health check to localhost times out or returns a generic http.sys/IIS 503 HTML page, not app JSON
Looks exactly like a hung process; app code is fine
After an unclean kill, even the correct hostname hangs indefinitely (wedged request queue)
explanation: HttpListener prefixes registered for the literal `localhost` hostname are scoped at the http.sys kernel level; requests to 127.0.0.1/[::1] send a different Host header, don't match, and http.sys answers 503 itself without reaching the app. Client and server must agree on hostname. Separately, an uncleanly-killed prior instance can leave a wedged http.sys request queue that hangs even correct requests — a clean service restart clears it.
diagnosis: netsh http show urlacl and netsh http show servicestate view=requestq show what's registered and receiving. Probe the backing service (e.g. Ollama /api/tags) separately — if it answers instantly, the hang is the router layer, not model loading.
